github_actions.notes: The generated workflow uses GitHub Actions and the GitHub Pages artifact/deploy actions. It does not publish directly through a GitHub API adapter. Supports a config-validated repository_dispatch event from an explicitly selected GitHub source repository/branch; the exact event commit SHA is fetched by the git_subtree source integration.

gitlab_ci.notes: Generates a GitLab CI pipeline using an operator-supplied OCI image pinned by sha256 digest. publishing.dry_run=true generates validation/build jobs only; live Pages deployment requires explicit dry_run=false and is restricted to deploy_branch. The image must contain the configured Python minor version, Git and git-subtree; Git LFS is checked when an input source enables LFS.

git.notes: Other VCS providers and source materialization modes are not implemented.

artifact.scope: Validated site artifact handoff to a configured GitHub Actions or GitLab CI workflow; the workflow performs its native Pages deployment. It is not a remote hosting API client.

filesystem.scope: Validated local filesystem copy with atomic replacement options.

command.scope: Explicit operator-supplied argv with allowlisted environment; no implicit shell or built-in provider API.

authoring_links.notes: provider/provider_label does not select an adapter. The URL is produced by the explicit edit_url_template and shared path mapping/encoding.

keycloak_asciidoc.scope: Keycloak AsciiDoc header-link classification into independent edit, issue and neighbor-page classes. Edit links validate against the configured source repository/ref before mapping to the configured authoring target; issue links match explicit URL prefixes independent of anchor text; neighbor links match explicit absolute/root-relative or page-relative selectors and exclude static downloads/assets. Each destination is resolved independently from config.

communication.notes: Communication URLs use the generic template formatter and configured host allowlists; no GitHub/GitLab/Bitbucket issue or discussion API client is included.
